name: video-pip
note: Rounds 9-11 (operator UAT 2026-08-10/12). THREE video states, ONE element, the iframe never remounts (audio never dies): THEATER - floating card overlay, never document flow ('rather not have video embedded in page'), taps reach the embed (YouTube's Skip lives there), and the card carries its OWN minimize handle ('include a button to minimize that is stuck to the PIP overlay' - the bar has NO video CTA in any state, its shape is constant); PIP - docked 152x86 above the bar, tap expands to theater (opening the Studio behind it - the primary expand affordance since the title became the toggle), with the park HANDLE stuck to its LEFT edge; HID - parked INTO the bar title, zero-size clip with audio alive. The bar's LEFT zone (eq + title/meta) TOGGLES the dock both ways ('clicking the song name or even the whole left part... to show and hide the small docked pip'), session-sticky. Plus round 9's scrub (synthesized infoDelivery) and refocus honesty (synthetic visibilitychange). Native requestPictureInPicture is unreachable for a cross-origin YT iframe - the PIP is a CSS overlay by design.

steps.label: ROW-TAP PLAY -> the PIP shows immediately over the library (min, fixed, docked above the bar) with the park handle stuck to its LEFT edge; iframe fingerprinted for the never-remounts proof
steps.js: (function(){var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('min'))return false;if(getComputedStyle(m).position!=='fixed')return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>130&&r.width<170&&r.height>60))return false;var bar=document.querySelector('.bt-st-head').getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.bottom<=bar.top+2))return false;var h=document.querySelector('[data-piphide]');if(!h)return false;var hr=h.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(hr.width>=24&&hr.height>=44))return false;if(!(hr.right<=r.left&&r.left-hr.right<14))return false;var f=m.querySelector('iframe');if(!f)return false;window.__pipFrame=f;return true;})()

steps.label: PARK: the handle collapses the PIP INTO the bar title - media zero-size but the SAME iframe stays connected (audio alive), player wears .vidhid, the handle is gone, and the title grows the video cue (::before chip)
steps.js: (function(){var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('hid'))return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width<2&&r.height<2))return false;var f=m.querySelector('iframe');if(f!==window.__pipFrame||!f.isConnected)return false;var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('vidhid'))return false;var h=document.querySelector('[data-piphide]');if(h&&h.getBoundingClientRect().width>0)return false;var cue=getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.bt-st-t'),'::before').content;return cue&&cue!=='none';})()

steps.label: UN-PARK: a left-zone tap brings the PIP back (min, visible, same iframe) WITHOUT expanding the Studio - the bar is the video's collapsed form
TOGGLE both ways: the same left-zone tap PARKS the showing PIP again (round 11 - 'show and hide the small docked pip'), still mini, audio-alive iframe untouched

PIP tap = the expand affordance: one tap opens the Studio AND promotes the video to THEATER - fixed floating card (never document flow), NO click-catcher (taps reach the embed - Skip is tappable HERE), same iframe, the card's OWN minimize handle at its bottom, the bar keeps pp visible (constant shape - no bar video CTA exists), menu reads Minimize video, countdown (if live) fully BELOW the card; countdown cancelled for determinism
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('vidopen')||p.classList.contains('mini'))return false;if(document.querySelector('[data-vidmin]'))return false;var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||m.classList.contains('min')||m.classList.contains('hid'))return false;if(getComputedStyle(m).position!=='fixed')return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(Math.abs(r.width-392)<3&&r.top>40&&r.top<120))return false;if(getComputedStyle(m,'::after').content!=='none')return false;if(m.querySelector('iframe')!==window.__pipFrame)return false;var h=document.querySelector('[data-thmin]');if(!h)return false;var hr=h.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(hr.height>20&&Math.abs(hr.bottom-r.bottom)<3&&hr.width>300))return false;var pp=document.querySelector('.bt-player [data-nppp]');if(!pp||pp.offsetParent===null)return false;var vt=document.querySelector('[data-vidtoggle]');if(!vt||vt.textContent.trim()!=='Minimize video')return false;var cd=document.querySelector('[data-countdown]');if(cd&&!cd.classList.contains('done')){var cr=cd.getBoundingClientRect();if(cr.top<r.bottom-2)return false;}var k=document.querySelector('[data-keepopen]');if(k)k.click();return true;})()

steps.label: SCRUB (in theater - the bar transport stays live): synthesize the embed's duration report, then pointer-drag the progress bar to ~60% - the fill tracks the finger and lands at 60, same iframe untouched
steps.js: (function(){window.dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent('message',{data:JSON.stringify({event:'infoDelivery',info:{duration:100,currentTime:10}})}));var p=document.querySelector('[data-npprog]');if(!p)return false;var r=p.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>0))return false;var x0=r.left+r.width*0.2,x1=r.left+r.width*0.6,y=r.top+r.height/2;function ev(type,x){p.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type,{pointerId:7,clientX:x,clientY:y,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));}ev('pointerdown',x0);ev('pointermove',x1);ev('pointerup',x1);var now=parseInt(p.getAttribute('aria-valuenow'),10);var w=parseFloat(document.querySelector('[data-npfill]').style.width);return now===60 && Math.abs(w-60)<2 && document.querySelector('.bt-st-media iframe')===window.__pipFrame;})()

steps.label: REFOCUS HONESTY: a visibility return while marked playing flips the bar to PAUSED (play glyph, npPaused class) - backgrounding always pauses the embed, the bar must never lie
the card's own handle minimizes the theater to the PIP (min, docked, park handle back) - the bar never carried the CTA
the PIP SURVIVES the whole Studio minimizing to the bar - still fixed, still visible above the now-playing bar, over the library list
